Premium studio claymation scene - everything sculpted from matte plasticine with refined intentional craftsmanship: subtle tool marks, controlled texture, soft rounded geometry, slight subsurface warmth, macro lens feel with shallow depth of field, soft diffused studio lighting with a gentle rim glow, the scene filling the entire frame with the camera inside the miniature clay world. References: none attached (text to image).

Subject and pose: one single modern clay smartphone (one body, one screen, one rim), sculpted as a professional clay imitation of a black-glass phone, with a rounded terracotta #C8553D clay case rim, no logo, no buttons visible, stands upright on its bottom edge left of centre, its box from 8% to 66% of the frame width and from 30% to 86% of the frame height, screen facing the camera. Hands: no hands visible anywhere in the frame; the small person's long sweater sleeves cover the hands, which hold nothing and touch nothing.

Action as contact points: the person's front foot is flat on the cream clay floor and the back foot lifts at the heel, mid-stride, walking to the right, away from the phone; the phone's bottom edge rests on the floor; one heart lies flat on the floor between the phone and the person.

Props with content: The phone screen shows a clay booking page: a cream band across the top of the screen holding the words "BOOK A CALL" in heavy bold deep ink #2B2A33 capital letters spanning the screen width; under it a big calendar grid of 3 rows by 5 columns of plain cream clay squares with thin ink outlines, every square empty: no digits, no names, no marks. One plump thumb-pressed clay heart in heart red #D64545 lies flat on the floor at about 62% to 72% of the width, 82% to 88% of the height.

Text: exactly "BOOK A CALL", capital letters, on the cream band at the top of the phone screen, at about 14% to 60% of the frame width and 36% to 42% of the frame height; nothing covers any letter. No other text anywhere.

Setting and background: a soft cream clay floor meeting a plain cream clay backdrop, softly out of focus; no signs, frames, posters or other screens. The top 30% of the frame is plain empty cream backdrop.

Camera: straight on at screen height, the camera inside the miniature clay world, macro lens feel, shallow depth of field, vertical 9:16; top 30% calm and empty, bottom 15% calm.

Continuity: first frame of the reel; nothing carried over.

Negatives: no logo, wordmark, real app name or app icon anywhere; no digits or numbers anywhere; no words other than the quoted ones; nothing at all in the top 30% of the frame except the plain cream backdrop; no faces; no set edges, workbench or room outside the clay world; no glossy CGI look.

Everything in frame is real professionally sculpted matte plasticine, photographed - refined sculpting marks, real cast shadows, soft studio lighting, the clay scene filling the entire frame.
